reuse.why: Extends the existing shared fill-rules.shouldFillCategory used by every month-wide action and the existing getBudgetData query instead of adding new filtering.

duplication.why: The template check is written once in hasSavedTemplates; only minor redundancy remains (c.goal_def selected next to c.*, and hidden filtering still also done in the average actions' SQL as before).

placement.why: The new rule lives in fill-rules.ts, the module the tree designates as the single definition of which categories month-wide actions fill.

scope.why: Focused on the request, though it adds no-op `c.goal_def` columns to three `SELECT c.*` queries and removes the now-unused 'include' policy.

maintainability.why: A maintainer gets one predicate for the template rule and a cleaner HiddenPolicy type; the redundant SQL columns and the defensive JSON parsing are small blemishes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions keep calling shouldFillCategory; no action re-checks templates locally.

disguised_duplication.where: No duplicated logic; hasSavedTemplates is a single new predicate.

one_place.where: Template rule added once in fill-rules.ts shouldFillCategory/hasSavedTemplates; copyPreviousMonth, setZero and set3/6/12MonthAvg all reach it, and setZero's hidden handling switched to the shared 'skip-hidden' policy.
